import numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc


class Turbojet(pyc.Cycle):
    def setup(self):
        thermo = dict(thermo_method='TABULAR', thermo_data=pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC)

        self.add_subsystem('fc', pyc.FlightConditions(**thermo))
        self.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet(**thermo))
        self.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor(**thermo))
        self.add_subsystem('burner', pyc.Combustor(**thermo))
        self.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine(**thermo))
        self.add_subsystem('nozz', pyc.Nozzle(**thermo))
        self.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft(num_ports=2))

        self.connect('fc.Fl_O:tot', 'inlet.Fl_I')
        self.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
        self.connect('comp.Fl_O', 'burner.Fl_I')
        self.connect('burner.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
        self.connect('turb.Fl_O', 'nozz.Fl_I')
        self.connect('fc.Fl_O:stat:P', 'nozz.Ps')

        self.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'comp.Nmech')
        self.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'turb.Nmech')
        self.connect('comp.perf.trq', 'shaft.trq_1')
        self.connect('turb.perf.trq', 'shaft.trq_2')

        self.add_subsystem('fn_calc', om.ExecComp(
            'Fn = Fg - mdot * V0 - drag',
            Fn={'units': 'lbf'}, Fg={'units': 'lbf'},
            mdot={'units': 'lbm/s'}, V0={'units': 'ft/s'},
            drag={'units': 'lbf'}))
        self.connect('nozz.perf.Fg', 'fn_calc.Fg')
        self.connect('fc.Fl_O:stat:V', 'fn_calc.V0')
        self.connect('fc.W', 'fn_calc.mdot')
        self.connect('inlet.perf.drag', 'fn_calc.drag')

        self.connect('bal_w.W', 'fc.W')

        self.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver(solve_subsystems=True,

        self.nonlinear_solver.linesearch = om.ArmijoGoldsteinLS()
        self.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()
